| Grant | Funder | Amount & Currency | Announced | Project dates | Status | Role of IPP/ITED | Source |

> **Note**: The EUROfusion/Euratum grant is institutional-level (IPP receives an overall consortium share for ITER NBI test facilities and ITER diagnostics preparation); the exact euro amount allocated to ITED is not publicly broken out on EUROfusion or CORDIS press releases I could verify.

### 2.2 Grants awarded to IPP broader institute (likely partially consumed by ITED but not exclusively)

| Grant | Funder | Amount & Currency | Announced | Project dates | Status | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| BMBF "Fusion 2040 — Research towards a fusion power plant" — joint IPP + Proxima Fusion | German Federal Ministry of Education & Research (BMBF) | ~€4M to IPP, total joint project ~€10M | 22 Apr 2024 | Project kicked off with workshop 18 Jun 2024 | Active | [2_recent_active_funding_announced_2024_01_01[1]] [33], [2_recent_active_funding_announced_2024_01_01[2]] [34] |
| DOE FIRE Collaboratives — "Advanced Profile Prediction for Fusion Pilot Plant Design" | U.S. Department of Energy, Office of Science (Fusion Energy Sciences) | Total US$14M across the collaborative; ~US$2M sub-award to IPP | 31 Jan 2025 | Multi-year FIRE project | Active | [2_recent_active_funding_announced_2024_01_01[3]] [37] |

**Caveat**: Both BMBF and DOE FIRE funding is led by IPP groups outside ITED (the BMBF project is jointly with Proxima Fusion and focuses on stellarator power-plant concept work; the DOE FIRE project is led by Prof. Frank Jenko's Tokamak Theory division). These are NOT ITED-exclusive funds; they appear here only for transparency because they are the principal IPP-wide grants announced after 2024-01-01.

### 2.3 EUROfusion programme funding of ITER NBI preparation (pre-2024 baseline, ongoing)

The IPP ITED division operates the ELISE (Extraction from a Large Ion Source Experiment) and BATMAN Upgrade test beds in Garching under the long-running EUROfusion programme "Preparation of ITER Operation" (PrIO). EUROfusion's Programme Manager publicly stated IPP is contributing "six full-time professionals to the ELISE facility and fourteen to the ITER Neutral Beam Test Facility" (NBTF, Consorzio RFX Padova). This is the principal sustained funding stream for ITED's ITER work.

content.6_synthesis_what_this_means_for_engaging:
**Direct outreach path**: The acting head of ITED, Prof. Dr. Ursel Fantz, is the appropriate first contact (ursel.fantz@ipp.mpg.de). The ITED division website (https://www.ipp.mpg.de/technologie) and the subgroup pages (NBI: https://www.ipp.mpg.de/3703903/nbi, ITER Diagnostics: https://www.ipp.mpg.de/3704112/diagnostik) are the canonical channels.

**Funding reality**: ITED's funding is overwhelmingly programmatic — institutional via the EUROfusion/Euratom Co-Funded Partnership — rather than project-grant-based. The BMBF "Fusion 2040" 4M€ and DOE FIRE ~2M€ to IPP are IPP-wide grants not earmarked for ITED.

**Hiring reality**: ITED hiring is not done via standalone open adverts; it flows through the EUROfusion "Beneficiary" or "Task" secondment mechanism or through IPP's general career portal. PhD students are typically hired through the IPP International Max Planck Research School (IMPRS) on Plasma Physics (https://www.ipp.mpg.de/imprs) or via the Helmholtz graduate school. **No PhD-specific ITED funding line was publicly retrievable.**
